directions: Plant in moist, well-drained, humus-rich, acidic soil in partial shade to morning sun with afternoon shade. Crown Jewel bears extra-large, fully double, intensely fragrant white flowers, among the biggest blooms of any commonly grown gardenia cultivar, opening against dense, glossy dark-green foliage typical of the species. The dense, rounded shrub makes a good foundation or specimen planting near a porch, window, or path where its exceptional bloom size and fragrance can be appreciated up close. Like all gardenias it is sensitive to soil pH, developing yellow, chlorotic leaves if the soil is not sufficiently acidic, so acidifying fertilizer and consistent moisture are key to keeping it healthy and free-flowering.
